import json
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from part2.capital_flow import runner

def test_two_successful_refreshes_keep_persisted_generation_coherent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    paused, release = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    def gated_write(path, payload):
        original(path, payload)
        if threading.current_thread().name == 'writer-A' and Path(path).name == 'latest.json':
            paused.set()
            assert release.wait(10), 'writer-A release timeout'
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner, 'atomic_write_json', gated_write)
    results, errors = {}, {}
    def refresh(label, timestamp):
        try:
            results[label] = runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=timestamp)
        except BaseException as exc:
            errors[label] = repr(exc)
    a = threading.Thread(target=refresh, args=('A', 1800000000000), name='writer-A')
    b = threading.Thread(target=refresh, args=('B', 1800000060000), name='writer-B')
    a.start()
    try:
        assert paused.wait(10), 'writer-A did not pause'
        b.start()
        b.join(10)
        assert not b.is_alive(), 'writer-B did not finish'
    finally:
        release.set()
        a.join(10)
    assert not a.is_alive(), 'writer-A did not finish'
    assert errors == {}
    assert set(results) == {'A', 'B'}
    assert not (tmp_path / 'observations.jsonl').exists()
    names = ('latest.json', 'audit_latest.json', 'anata_latest.json')
    stamps = tuple(json.loads((tmp_path / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['as_of_ms'] for name in names)
    assert len(set(stamps)) == 1, f'persisted generation mismatch: {dict(zip(names, stamps))}'
